text: {"text":"The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. The familiar framing is that this supports broader rollout; the more precise conclusion is that the evidence is inadequate for that purpose, because the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. Note the consequential distinction: this is not a rejection of every deployment, but a bounded approval. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before broader rollout."}
